purpose: Fleet-scale Forge v2 search for the paper and README: (1) does island evolution beat equal-budget random search on the forge-v2 objective across independent replicates, and (2) how far does search seeded from the last best design (Forge v2 demo) improve on it. Registered before any fleet run starts; only the pilots C0 and P-repro below were run before registration.

source.registration_change: adds the optional campaign field closure_seed (absent: closure samples come from seed, exactly as before; forge-v2 digest unchanged and pinned by test closure_seed_lets_replicates_share_one_objective) and campaigns/forge-v2-fleet/seed-20261101..20261109.json
source.run_binary: built from this registration commit with `cargo build --release --locked -p joil-forge` (Rust 1.95.0, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu); its SHA-256 is recorded in the launch receipt before the first fleet job starts. Replicate 8 runs on macOS aarch64 (rustc 1.97.1, platform libm) and is disclosed as a platform difference.

objective.fleet_campaigns: campaigns/forge-v2-fleet/seed-<seed>.json: forge-v2 with name, seed (search randomness), population 96 and islands 4 changed and closure_seed fixed at 20261021, so every run is scored under the forge-v2 closure samples. Objective weights, limits, duties, envelope, terminals and resolution are identical (checked by test).
objective.no_tuning: No threshold, duty, weight, limit, envelope, resolution or closure is changed after registration.

last_best_spot.receipt_seeds: seeds/receipt-bests.json = [best.genome of docs/forge/results/forge-v2-demo-receipt.json (genome 502bd6d6...), best.genome of forge-v1-demo-receipt.json (genome 9aefcbd4...)], file sha256 945d37d22438449e5cd677d58584fb24828150365ebec38b22a964b0696340f9
last_best_spot.rescored_under_1_1_1: v2 best: feasible, report fitness 2.479878543960991 (identical to the receipt); v1 best: infeasible under forge-v2 (796 mm part > 400 mm build height; cell 43 diameters long > 30)
last_best_spot.C0: pilot: evolve --campaign campaigns/forge-v2.json --seed-from seeds/receipt-bests.json --generations 300 (2 x 48), binary c665422351428df95f133142b8edb11e496b62cbc626860f3c18e126c2b86a20 built from fc26a40; final checkpoint sha256 cbd27d51b203cbbc2fda1b6940b8be70acc55c6ec1eaa8a2523cc0a2dc3a47ba (300 generations, 28896 evaluations, best search fitness 2.499, 363 niches of which 6 feasible, peak RSS 33.6 MB)
last_best_spot.P_repro: pilot: de novo evolve --campaign campaigns/forge-v2.json --generations 300 (replays the v2 demo protocol on 1.1.1, run straight through rather than 150 + resume); compared with the demo receipt, not used as a seed

arms.S: seeded continuation: evolve --campaign seed-N.json --seed-from <C0 run dir> --generations 2000
arms.R: equal-budget random search: control --campaign seed-N.json --evaluations 768384 (batches of 384). Evolve counts every scored proposal including cache hits, so D and R spend exactly 96 x 4 x 2001 = 768384 evaluations.
arms.C: exact continuation of the rebuilt last best: evolve --run <copy of C0> --resume --generations 2000 (forge-v2, 2 x 48)
arms.P: pooled final run: evolve --campaign seed-20261109.json --seed-from pool.json --generations 2000, where pool.json is the deduplicated union of archive elites, best and island leaders (run::load_seeds) of S-1..8 and D-1..8 after they finish

replicates.order_per_slot: S then D then R for one seed; results do not depend on thread count (tests/forge.rs)

endpoints.primary: Per replicate N: D-N best at 768384 evaluations versus R-N best at the same budget, ranked by the engine's own order (feasible before infeasible, then higher fitness, else lower violation). One-sided exact sign test over the 8 replicates, H1 = evolution better; ties count against H1. p <= 0.05 needs at least 7 of 8 wins.
secondary: evaluations to the first feasible design, D-N vs R-N (R censored at the budget if never feasible)
feasible archive niches at the end, D-N vs R-N
S-N vs D-N best fitness at 2000 generations (does seeding from the last best help at equal budget)
S-N, C and P best search fitness versus the rebuilt last best (C0 start and the v2 receipt best, 2.4799 at report resolution)
overall best design across S, D, C and P: report-resolution re-evaluation, per-duty outlet at the worst closure, treated capacity, mass, print audit and CAD from `joil-forge report`
exploratory: re-evaluate the overall best under closure_seed 20261101..20261108 (24 further closure samples) and report the worst case
sensitivity of the primary test with replicate 8 (macOS) excluded
if the fleet window allows, resume S-N and P to 4000 generations; reported as exploratory, never replacing the 2000-generation endpoints

reporting: Every replicate is reported, including unfavourable ones. Numbers are unvalidated reduced-order screen outputs, not physical performance. Seed choice, budgets and thresholds are fixed here and are not tuned after seeing outcomes.

invalidation_and_stops.crash_or_interruption: an evolve run is resumed exactly from its checkpoint and the interruption is recorded; an interrupted R control is rerun with the identical command (deterministic) and recorded
invalidation_and_stops.missing_data: a replicate without both D and R at budget is reported as missing and counted against H1
invalidation_and_stops.numerical_failures: kept as recorded by the engine; never hidden or rescored
invalidation_and_stops.host_guards: fleetcap run-capped on Linux; pause our own processes on memory/disk/freeze breaches or an Admiral/owner stop; no early stopping on performance
